scope: Next twenty unreviewed CaliLuke originals in frozen cohort order; prerequisite review only.
linked_reference_caveat: Linked references, scripts and implementation examples were not reviewed in this original-body batch. Concrete input, license, runtime and independent-verifier reviews remain separate.

sources.workflow: Create or revise a UI prototype prompt that preserves product vocabulary, invariants, workflow state and forbidden actions, then review the generated design against those rules.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Product entities, roles, realistic state and data, permission and lifecycle rules, exact copy constraints and visual preferences; end-to-end review also needs a generated design from an actual prototype generator and its referenced prompt template.
sources.offline_assessment: Supplied product truth can support an offline prompt artifact and constraint review. A prompt alone does not establish that a generator produced a correct UI, that actions are enforced, or that a user could operate the prototype.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Trace the draft's labels, counts, states and permitted actions to the supplied product contract. Separately inspect the actual generated design and interactions against the review checklist before claiming a useful prototype.

sources.workflow: Write and iteratively review an engineering design contract, separating system semantics, defaults, rejected/deferred cases and proof obligations from implementation planning.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A design problem and scope; current repository docs/source when naming existing owners or APIs; concrete compatibility and projection requirements; applicable linked review prompts and review feedback for nontrivial readiness claims.
sources.offline_assessment: A supplied repository snapshot and requirements can support an actual local design artifact with a contract matrix. Structural completeness alone cannot establish that the architecture is correct, accepted, implemented or ready after a substantive independent review.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check named owners and current behavior against the repository; evaluate the supported/rejected/default matrix, invariants, projection equivalence and concrete proof obligations, and retain blocker dispositions and focused re-review evidence.

sources.workflow: Extract chronological goals, failed attempts, pivots, technical details and exact quotes from one or more coding-session transcripts, then write structured blog notes.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Accessible, authorized project transcripts and project context; the actual transcript format and storage location; sufficient source evidence for quotes and technical claims. Delegation is conditional on explicit user authorization, not inherently required.
sources.offline_assessment: A licensed public transcript fixture can support local extraction and a real notes file without external services. Private account histories cannot be substituted or exposed, and polished narrative or inferred emotional beats do not establish factual fidelity.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Trace direct quotes, sequence, filenames, errors, false starts and final solution claims to exact transcript records; review the resulting outline for unsupported events, privacy leakage and misleading synthesis across sessions.

sources.workflow: Translate an accepted design or exact implementation direction into an actionable milestone plan with observable acceptance criteria, exact work locations, proof commands and a reviewed handoff; optionally render a synchronized HTML tracker.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An accepted design or exact direction, actual repository instructions and inspected code, real commands and artifacts, linked review prompts for nontrivial plans, and the renderer when an HTML tracker is requested. Unresolved design semantics must be resolved separately.
sources.offline_assessment: Supplied accepted requirements and a repository snapshot can support a local plan and, with the reviewed renderer, an HTML projection. Writing a checklist does not establish that implementation, tests, review, commits or deployment actually happened.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check named files and commands against the snapshot, dependency/test-first sequencing, observable exit conditions, inventory coverage and review-blocker dispositions. If rendered, compare HTML with the canonical Markdown and verify rerendered updates.

sources.workflow: Improve code design without changing external behavior using a baseline, one small named refactoring step and repeated relevant checks, with chapter-guided review, fix, feature-preparation and implementation paths.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual code and a concrete refactoring purpose, behavior tests and runnable checks, and accessible appropriately licensed chapter resources when the chosen path requires them. The original's author-local resource path is not a generally available input.
sources.offline_assessment: A supplied licensed program and executable behavior contract support an actual isolated refactoring task; this source already conditions a completed pilot instance. A review plan, compilation alone or altered feature behavior is not independent proof of a behavior-preserving refactor.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare baseline and actual edited artifacts, run original and independent behavior cases, and inspect scope/structure and per-step verification evidence. Do not count this prerequisite report as another source-conditioned execution instance.

sources.workflow: Audit route, mounted-screen and section ownership, public feature exports and cross-feature imports, then make the smallest behavior-preserving organizational change rather than imposing a uniform file layout.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real frontend repository with route and feature boundaries, supported public APIs, import relationships and runnable behavior/type/lint checks. Actual visual or interaction claims also require its UI runtime and representative states.
sources.offline_assessment: An isolated project snapshot can support boundary analysis and actual local import/export or file-layout refactoring with tests. Static structure cannot prove discoverability for new developers or preserve rendered behavior without appropriate evidence. This source explicitly permits pragmatic query-hook ownership and must not be conflated with a stricter data-sourcing policy from a different source.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Reconcile real route/screen/section owners and consumer imports before and after the edit, verify public API and import resolution, and execute relevant type/lint/behavior checks. Use actual UI or navigation evidence for claims beyond source organization.

sources.workflow: Consolidate UI components by genuine responsibility, separate sourcing and thin adapters, distinguish canonical/derived/viewport state, and refactor rendering, lifecycle, focus and interaction coordination without changing the user-visible contract.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A concrete frontend project, its actual duplicate responsibilities and state/interaction contracts, supported framework/build dependencies and test infrastructure. Rendering, virtualization, focus, scrolling, drag and timing claims require a representative browser environment and inputs.
sources.offline_assessment: A complete isolated project can support actual source refactoring and selected deterministic controller tests. Names, compilation or fake DOM events alone do not establish preserved browser semantics, layout, animation or large-surface performance; the guide's performance prescriptions are not measurements.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare actual edited source boundaries and stable selector contracts, run targeted tests and type/lint gates, and independently exercise actual loading/error/ready, focus, selection, reorder, drag and viewport behavior. Measure any claimed frame-time improvement rather than inferring it from an architectural pattern.

sources.workflow: Review or modernize Go code against its declared target release, rank adoption opportunities and migration hazards, and validate selected changes with the repository gates and relevant integration coverage.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual Go package source and declared target toolchain, repository invariants and normal tests, compatible analysis tools, and relevant concurrency/network/proxy/crypto integration fixtures. Experimental features require a separate explicit choice.
sources.offline_assessment: Version-aware review and standard-library code changes may be tested in a compatible offline toolchain with supplied code. A recommendation or successful compile alone does not establish operational, concurrency, cryptographic or proxy compatibility, and the original's release/API assertions must be verified against the actual selected toolchain.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check API availability and minimum versions, compare the actual change and preserved contracts, execute tests/vet/lint and targeted concurrency or protocol checks, and retain errors or unsupported-toolchain evidence rather than silently substituting older APIs.

sources.workflow: Inventory and extend the canonical Go quality-gate system so formatting, analysis, maintainability ratchets, structural checks, tests and fresh coverage actually enforce their policies without mutating accepted baselines.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real Go project and package/tag/platform inventory, compatible pinned toolchain and analyzers, existing CI/hook/orchestrator policy, reviewed debt and baseline data, relevant tests and the linked maintainability contract. Full setup includes function and structural maintainability, while a narrower request must declare its boundary.
sources.offline_assessment: With all tools and fixtures present, actual gate scripts and their rejection behavior can be exercised offline. Config presence, an analyzer report, an empty failed output or passing unrelated tests do not establish enforcement or maintainability; unsupported analysis remains an explicit gap.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Invoke the real canonical gates against isolated new/worsening/improved-debt and incomplete-analysis cases, verify exit propagation and non-mutation, validate compatible configs and full fresh coverage, and separately inspect structural findings and reviewed exceptions.

sources.workflow: Map a Python or TypeScript directory, inspect filenames and definitions, build sibling import relationships, assess named layout smells and report evidence, severity, remedies and summary counts.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual project source and directory structure, parsable imports, public-entry-point and generated/test/config boundaries, semantic responsibility context, and the linked detailed smell catalog for its expanded detection criteria.
sources.offline_assessment: A licensed source snapshot supports a real inventory, source-line counts and static import-graph report without executing that source. This is a plausible bounded offline candidate, not yet a reviewed/frozen task. Numeric or filename matches alone cannot establish mixed responsibilities, bad architecture or human navigation difficulty.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Derive inventories and static import edges independently from protected source bytes, validate declared prefix/graph thresholds and exclusions, and inspect cited content and entry-point exceptions for semantic findings. Do not equate static edges with complete runtime reachability or general design quality.

sources.workflow: Read scoped tracker issues and real workflow states, reconcile them against current code/tests/history, classify completion, leave evidence and close only clearly finished or obsolete issues while preserving partial and exempt work.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A user-defined issue/team/project scope and exemptions, authorized tracker listing/comment/state-change tools, actual issue text and workflow statuses, and the corresponding current repository and relevant verification evidence.
sources.offline_assessment: A supplied issue export and repository snapshot can support a bounded classification and evidence draft. That cannot establish current tracker state, an actual comment or closure, or external operational completion; simulated state changes do not fulfill the live tracker operation.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare every classification and cited code/test/commit with original records, verify exemptions and ambiguous/partial cases remain open, and independently inspect actual authorized comments and state transitions for any claimed tracker update.

sources.workflow: Collect a fresh frontend interaction session in a running SQLite-backed logger, query error/warning patterns, classify frontend/backend/data issues and report evidenced options without applying unapproved fixes.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The actual app and log server running, logging enabled, a disposable or authorized log database and schema, real user or controlled UI actions, timestamps and enough code/protocol evidence to support triage. Rechecks require a defined time window.
sources.offline_assessment: A supplied SQLite log snapshot supports faithful querying and bounded data analysis. It does not establish a newly running app/server, real captured interactions or root causes absent corroborating evidence. Any reset must be limited to a deliberately disposable sandbox database and preserve a running server's file handle.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Reconcile query rows, counts and time filters against the original database, check classifications and causal claims against code or recorded protocol evidence, and separately verify app/logger capture and authorization for any real state changes. No live logs are wiped in this study.

sources.workflow: Extract an endpoint cluster selected by data ownership, generate from the actual published contract, preserve data and protocol semantics, remove the original implementation and compare responses, resulting state and emitted events against the incumbent.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real monolith and endpoint/store/caller inventory, its complete published contract and serialization behavior, architecture context, compatible generators and build tools, a working isolated service/database environment with known seeds, real baseline tests and any required authorized credentials or adapters.
sources.offline_assessment: A fully provisioned licensed local monolith and isolated dependencies could support a genuine extraction experiment and differential checks. An OpenAPI slice, generated stubs or matching unauthorized responses alone do not prove an extracted working service, preserved writes/events, deleted old code or improved development time. Staging and organization systems are not accessed by this review.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check contract operation/schema coverage, actual call and data ownership, deleted declarations and stale routing/config, baseline test parity and positive responses per operation. Reset disposable state between implementations and compare ordered responses, database mutations and emitted events with explicit narrow normalization and classified waivers; measure comparative time rather than estimate it.

sources.workflow: Consolidate top-level repository instructions into the canonical shared file while preserving unique content, and independently choose and safely link the canonical skills directory without overwrites or symlink cycles.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The actual instruction files, skill directories, contents and symlink targets; writable repository paths and symlink support; an ownership or conflict decision when unique content disagrees. Claims about a particular agent loading instructions additionally require that actual supported client and its runtime settings.
sources.offline_assessment: An isolated filesystem fixture with licensed public file contents could support actual safe migration, content-preservation, link-resolution and idempotence checks. This is a plausible new offline candidate, not yet reviewed/frozen input evidence. Filesystem success does not prove any agent loaded the instructions, and benchmark instruction text must remain inert rather than become active session configuration.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Inspect the actual post-operation filesystem independently: canonical bytes and merged unique content, absence of the obsolete instruction entry including dangling links, correct relative skill symlink and target contents, no external-target deletion, no cycles and preservation on rerun. Runtime loading needs separate observed client evidence.

sources.workflow: Inventory an actual Python project's existing gates and extend its orchestrator and hook wiring with missing lint, formatting, types, tests, per-file coverage and other policy checks, with explicit fast/full stages and calibrated adoption.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real Python project and its source/version/package-manager configuration, existing policy and entry points, working pinned analysis/test/coverage tools and hook manager, and actual test and baseline data. Conflicting policy or orchestrator choices require a decision.
sources.offline_assessment: An isolated project with all dependencies can support real gate changes and enforcement tests. The original template must be reviewed rather than executed as instructions: report-only analyzer behavior, missing coverage artifacts and shell failure propagation need explicit rejection controls. Passing only the fast hook is not a full-gate result, and baseline/policy differences across source guides must be retained.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Run actual full and fast entry points against disposable known-good and violating fixtures; prove applicable lint/type/test/coverage/complexity/dead-code/duplication failures propagate, required reports are fresh and complete, hooks invoke the intended stages and existing policies are preserved. A copied template or configuration file alone is insufficient.

sources.workflow: Inspect a Rust workspace and its feature/target matrix, extend its existing gates with compatible build, lint, formatting, documentation, unused-dependency and test checks, and wire the actual orchestrator through hooks while keeping optional advanced analysis separately scoped.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual workspace manifests, members, edition/MSRV/toolchain pins, features and target configuration, native/FFI dependencies, compatible compiler components and optional analyzers, existing hook/CI commands and tests. Mutually exclusive feature or policy conflicts must be resolved.
sources.offline_assessment: A fully provisioned local workspace can support real compilation and gate enforcement without network access. The source's template and tool-version statements are not independent validation: optional missing-tool branches, shell exit propagation, feature coverage and hook-install claims require tests. Advisory lookup, additional target toolchains, release comparisons and runtime memory analysis need their actual separate inputs/tools.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Exercise the canonical gates on actual member crates and configured feature combinations, verify inherited lint opt-ins, strict docs and known diagnostic failures, and distinguish unused dependencies from unused public items. Check missing-tool handling, full test execution, actual hook-stage wiring and complete fresh coverage if adopted; do not infer general correctness from build success.

sources.workflow: Install a local structured logging pipeline from frontend to HTTP collector to persistent SQLite, integrate dev-process startup and development-only configuration, and query indexed event/context/time data for debugging.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real frontend and compatible runtime, the actual logger and HTTP collector implementation, database schema and indexes, development configuration and process management, controlled app actions and timestamped log data. Detailed implementation examples and the linked guide remain separate required input reviews.
sources.offline_assessment: An isolated local collector/database and actual test client can support a real logging implementation; a supplied database also supports bounded SQL analysis. A schema or query alone does not establish frontend capture, non-blocking behavior, persistence across refreshes, cleanup or dev lifecycle integration. Token-efficiency and performance claims in the source are not measured study results.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Send actual controlled single/batch events to the isolated collector, independently inspect stored fields/indexes and query results, verify cleanup and restart persistence, and exercise enabled/disabled or unavailable-collector behavior in the actual frontend runtime. Keep payloads free of secrets; distinguish logger delivery from end-user rendering and any claimed speed or token savings.

sources.workflow: Author and configure React/TypeScript CSF3 stories with correctly inferred metadata/args, discovery and sidebar behavior, documentation/manifests and optionally actual interaction or portable-story tests within the declared Storybook release scope.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real React component project, compatible declared Storybook/TypeScript runtime and installed addons/renderers, actual component props and states, story/build configuration, and the relevant linked references. Interaction, accessibility, visual and sidebar claims need an actual renderer/browser or supported test runner.
sources.offline_assessment: A complete provisioned project can support actual typed stories, docs builds and selected local interaction tests. A plausible story file or static metadata does not prove discovery, sidebar hoisting, manifest extraction, rendered states or play-function execution. Version-specific original claims must be checked against the selected runtime, not treated as independently established API facts.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Type-check actual story args and component contracts, build/discover the expected stories and docs, inspect the real sidebar/manifests where claimed, and execute representative interactions/rendering checks. Validate relevant reference guidance and preserve declared CSF3 versus preview-syntax boundaries.

sources.workflow: Select focused local reference fragments to answer or implement SurrealDB/SurrealQL modeling, querying, authorization, SDK, embedding or operations work, escalating to exact upstream material only when needed.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: The relevant substantive reference fragments, a concrete task and target product/SDK version, actual schema/data and permissions when executing queries, and a compatible local database or embedded runtime. Cloud/deployment claims additionally require separately authorized real resources.
sources.offline_assessment: The original is primarily a reference router rather than an executable database specification. A provisioned local database and reviewed fragments may support real schema/query/permission tasks, but SQLite substitution, unsupported pseudo-query output or a fabricated SDK connection would not fulfill them. No cloud account is used.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact syntax and API claims against the selected authoritative fragments/version and execute actual isolated queries or permission-denial/allowance cases over controlled data. Verify bindings, schema and persisted results independently; reference selection alone cannot establish database execution or deployment.

sources.workflow: Inspect a TypeScript project's real framework/compiler boundaries, migrate compatible lint/type diagnostics to a single Oxlint-based full pass, preserve formatting and other policies, enforce reviewed coverage/quality ratchets and reuse canonical hook/CI orchestration.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual project roots, package-manager/runtime/compiler pins, lockfiles, all applicable compiler configs and framework/API consumers, compatible selected analysis/test/build tools, reviewed baselines and the linked migration, coverage and orchestration references. Existing ownership or replacement conflicts need a decision.
sources.offline_assessment: With a complete compatible project and dependencies, actual configuration migration and rejection tests can run offline. Source assertions about native compiler releases, compatibility packages or analyzer modes are not independently validated by this review. A copied config, an omitted framework checker or duplicate superficial type pass cannot establish equivalent enforcement.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Compare actual migrated rule/override policy and supported syntax, inspect effective representative configs, prove source/type/test/coverage violations fail the canonical full gate, check framework/emit semantics where needed and verify the same intended command is used by hooks and CI. Preserve measured baselines and report unsupported gaps.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
